name: llm-review-triage
author: lrgthu
description: Standalone on-demand Area-Chair filter for LLM-generated peer reviews: separates high-leverage technical/experimental fixes from Limitation-Boomerangs, quota-filling nitpicks, false multi-LLM consensus, recursive multi-round drift, and defensive qualifier bloat that destroys a paper's soul.
suggestedPrompts: Filter these LLM-generated review comments like a senior Area Chair: protect our paper's core soul and already-stated limitations, and list only high-leverage fixes
Compare Round-1 vs Round-2 AI review comments on our draft, stop recursive drift, and flag any over-hedging or scope creep
Audit our revised draft diff after addressing review comments to strip defensive qualifier chains and restore crisp human scientific prose
